# Find All Minima nD

![Find All Minima nD function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/optimization/minima_nd.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Runs local searches from random points in a box and returns distinct minima as rows; discovery is not exhaustive.

## Types and connection rules

Runs local searches from random points in a box and returns distinct minima as rows; discovery is not exhaustive.
